topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Got a letter today, the kind with a waxy seal and a flourish of pen that ain't from no machine. It was from Jimmy, my old student, the one with the eyes like chips of broken ice but a heart softer than the underbelly of a midnight cat. In the envelope, there was a small, worn leather journal, the kind that whispers secrets and holds fleeting hopes tight. Alongside it, a note written in a rush, like a man running out of time but not out of things to say. He thanked me, for all the scribbled notes and late-night talks, for believing when he didn't. I flipped through the pages, each one a testament to a journey he's on, one that might've never started without a little nudge. It’s the kind of gift that’s not just a memory, but a promise kept, years down the road.
